punchline: Hubler was right, but he paid for his protection out of the same crack.
thirty_sec: Howie Hubler's Morgan Stanley group bought two billion dollars of CDS and sold swaps on sixteen billion dollars of AAA-rated CDOs to fund it; in the 2008 crisis the trade lost about nine billion dollars.
question: Could the backup you built fail for the same reason as the thing it protects?
key_contrast: Protection fails when what funds it carries the same risk.
